protocol.purpose: Release-quality multilingual qualification of production Ask, Daily Insights, Day Summary, and Activity Label through deterministic context budgets, purpose-specific native tool schemas, the decoder-forced exact Qwen function-call prefix, the strict parser, and the deterministic renderer.
protocol.change_reason: The non-qualifying V8 bounded preflight passed 7 of 8 stable cases with 91.6667% parser acceptance. The English Label perturbation-1 attempt produced the required native tool event, but production and perturbation-2 emitted the function arguments as bare JSON normal text; the strict parser correctly rejected both. Revision 9 forces the exact Qwen XML native-function prefix at decoder level for every built-in structured generation and selects a purpose-specific schema: Summary and Label expose only status, item1_text, and item1_sources, while Ask and Insights expose only their used fields and statuses. Production prompt versions, output caps, strict parser, no-repair rule, scorer, cases, and thresholds are unchanged.

provenance.source: Synthetic ZBS Eye-like cases authored for this protocol; no case is copied from user history.
provenance.stability: Protocol text, fixture bytes and hashes, case IDs and inputs, production prompt versions, channel selection, context policy, tool schema, parser, renderer, generation parameters, bounded-preflight selection, seed derivation, scoring, and thresholds are immutable within revision 9. Any correction requires revision 10.

bounded_preflight.relationship_to_release_gate: Diagnostic preflight only. It never substitutes for, reruns, or relabels the 64-case release gate.

case_distribution.uniqueness: All 64 case IDs and sorted-key canonical input JSON payloads must be globally unique.

ask.execution: Fixture retrieval is injected into AskService; a capture router records the exact production LLMRequest after production status hints, citation numbering, and LocalAIContextPolicy budget.

insights.execution: Fixture activity is reduced by LocalAIContextPolicy.insightsHints, then RoutedAIConsumerGenerator captures the exact production LLMRequest and structured source vocabulary.

summary.execution: Locked ordered slices cross the production deterministic context budget; the captured source set is the exact included subset. Date, session count, and frame count are coverage metadata, not citable history facts, and the shared English/Russian production prompt forbids restating them.

label.execution: The locked serialized activity block and language signals produce the production one-line label request. The 160-token cap covers Qwen3.5 XML tool-call framing; the prompt requires the most specific supplied project or topic and omits optional fields.

production_request_construction.no_bypass: Every physical generation uses the captured production LLMRequest and the same decoder-prefix generation helper as production; test-only prompt copies, prefix overlays, schema overlays, or parser repair are forbidden.

separated_channels.built_in_local: The captured ZBS Eye Local production request contains an unconditional instruction to call emit_zbs_eye_answer exactly once. The MLX decoder is seeded with the exact Qwen native-function prefix so the only accepted result is one native tool event with no normal text or bare JSON before or after it.
separated_channels.external: The external-provider production request contains no function-call branch and requires only final visible lines, Markdown, or label text.
separated_channels.selection: Channel selection is derived from the exact provider identity; executedLocally alone must not opt Ollama, LM Studio, or Custom into the built-in MLX tool channel.
separated_channels.quality_gate: The V9 physical gate qualifies the captured built-in local production request through the same purpose-specific schema and decoder-prefix helper as production. Synthetic external behavior remains covered by pure consumer tests.

structured_channel.prefix_scope: Every built-in structured generation, after the production chat template is prepared and before free decoding begins.
structured_channel.prefix_budget_accounting: Forced prefix tokens consume the existing maximum-output-token budget; V9 does not add hidden output tokens.
structured_channel.legacy_schema: The static full schema is retained only to reproduce immutable V3-V8 artifacts and is not used by V9 production or qualification.

seed_derivation.canonical_request:
NFC(protocol.id + '
' + protocol.revision + '
' + prompt_contract_id + '
' + case.id + '
' + sorted-key JSON(case.input))
seed_derivation.production: First 8 SHA-256 bytes of canonical_request, interpreted unsigned big-endian.
seed_derivation.stability: A case passes only when all three attempts pass. No retry, repair, or best-result selection.

scoring.parser_acceptance: Exactly one production tool call, zero normal model text, accepted by LocalAIAnswerToolContract without repair.
semantic_checks: expected typed status for consumer and answerability
all required concepts and exact quotes
no forbidden substring or invented number
scoring.summary_numeric_grounding: A number is output-grounded only when it appears verbatim inside an included source fragment. Date/session/frame coverage metadata remains outside allowed_numbers.
scoring.unsupported_denominator: Every attempted seed of each must_refuse Ask or Insights case.
scoring.stable_rates: Overall, language, and consumer rates use cases, not seed attempts; all three attempts must pass.
